status: Concept reference sheets for user review; not API-ready single-view files and not validated 3D geometry.
brief: Enlarge the existing mist-lilac beret, enclose both ears naturally, preserve kitten identity, forehead contact without face occlusion, rounded felt crown and restrained broad folds.

prompts.initialWorn:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: high-quality 3D accessory design turnaround for NAVA's existing white fluffy kitten, for artistic review BEFORE 3D reconstruction.
Input images: Image 1 is the current real APP kitten identity reference. Image 2 is the original approved kitten character design reference. Image 3 is the user's CURRENT BAD HAT screenshot: use its muted lilac color and beret category only; replace the undersized flat disc completely. Do not reproduce the phone or interface.
Create one polished landscape 3-by-2 character turnaround sheet, six large clear FULL-BODY views on a uniform very pale cool-gray background with generous whitespace. Top row: exact front, front three-quarter facing left, front three-quarter facing right. Bottom row: true left-facing profile, exact rear, true right-facing profile. All six depict the SAME kitten in the SAME seated neutral pose wearing the SAME naturally fitted generous lilac felt beret. Keep the kitten's existing proportions: large rounded fluffy white body, short small dark blue forepaws, deep navy softly graded oval face mask, two tiny white happy closed-eye arcs and small white triangular nose, layered soft cheek tufts and fluffy tail. No realistic cat eyes, no new mouth or whiskers, no face marks at rear. Maintain original character identity.
HAT DESIGN IS THE SUBJECT: a generously sized soft muted lavender WOOL FELT BERET with a genuinely three-dimensional rounded crown and a narrower soft oval head opening. Crown is about 1.25 times the forehead width and envelops BOTH ears entirely inside it: no visible white ear tips, no ear holes, no sharp ear-shaped points in the hat. A smooth broad domed body has enough volume for relaxed folded ears, sits down comfortably over the upper head, subtle natural sideways slouch. The soft lower band rests against the upper forehead and occiput ABOVE the face mask/eyes; preserve the complete face and cheek tufts. Thick but supple felt edge, small natural compression folds where the band meets the crown, asymmetric broad soft drape, a tiny short matching felt stem on top. No hard plate, pancake, donut brim, floating halo, helmet, baseball cap, decorative flowers, pompoms or extra clothes. Natural contact should gently compress the fur at the hat band, with no visible gap, no intersections. Lower band thickness and side-slouch orientation must remain geometrically consistent as the character rotates; backside must show the same hat continuing over the back of the head. Tail and face proportions remain consistent between views.
Style: refined soft stylized 3D illustration matching reference, premium tactile fine felt texture, restrained small folds, luminous soft icy white fur; evenly diffused all-around illumination, no dark cast shadows, no dramatic highlights, no floor horizon. Each view large enough to inspect fitting. Tiny understated Chinese view captions only beneath each: 正面, 左前45°, 右前45°, 左侧, 背面, 右侧. No other text, no UI, no watermark. Prioritize coherent volume, natural wear, accurate face identity and all ears concealed. High resolution landscape sheet.
prompts.perspectiveCorrection:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit this exact six-view character design sheet. Keep the generously sized soft lavender beret, its ear-covering volume, broad fold, felt texture, brim height, cat identity, pale background, six-panel 3x2 layout, and ALL bottom-row views and top-left front view unchanged. The two top-middle and top-right panels are incorrectly almost front-facing. Correct ONLY these two to unmistakable actual 45-degree three-quarter views, rotating the whole physical cat+hat together while holding the SAME camera height and seated posture.
Top-middle caption 左前45°: nose and muzzle direction toward IMAGE LEFT, face mask foreshortened to an oval narrower by about 30%, left-facing silhouette, nearer eye arc fully visible and far eye shortened, clear side of round head and body visible on IMAGE RIGHT, near/far paws at different horizontal depth offsets and partly overlapping, tail correspondingly rotated with body. It must be visibly halfway between the front view and left profile, not another frontal symmetric face.
Top-right caption 右前45°: the same cat+same exact hat genuinely yawed 45 degrees toward IMAGE RIGHT, visibly halfway between front and right profile. Face mask offset to IMAGE RIGHT, far eye foreshortened, cheek fur projection changes with perspective; hat's original asymmetrical slouch rotates physically with the head and must not randomly flip sides. Both new panels should look like a turntable, same identity and original body dimensions. No ears appear outside hat. Preserve the complete face, avoid added eyes/mouth/whiskers, no UI or other accessories. Final output high resolution landscape, visually precise original sheet with only the two perspective corrections.
prompts.isolated:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: standalone accessory modeling reference sheet for the SAME muted lavender wool-felt beret shown worn by the white kitten in the input image. The reference image is the approved-for-exploration design source, not a UI.
Generate a precise high-resolution landscape 3 columns x 2 rows PRODUCT TURNAROUND of ONLY THIS SINGLE HAT, with exactly six views on the same uniform pale cool-gray backdrop, every item fully contained and separate. No cat, no mannequin, no body, no furry fragments. Top row: exact orthographic FRONT, exact LEFT PROFILE, exact BACK. Bottom row: exact RIGHT PROFILE, overhead TOP, low oblique UNDERSIDE revealing the hat's actual oval opening and inner cavity. Put small neutral captions beneath: 正面, 左侧, 背面, 右侧, 顶部, 帽口结构.
Design MUST remain the same physical hat across every view. Large soft rounded crown, muted lilac lavender fine matte wool-felt, a slightly asymmetrical slouch, 2-3 broad restrained compression folds close to the lower edge, soft rounded edge, short simple same-color felt stem on top. This beret is generously tall and deep enough to enclose the kitten's ears shown in the reference. Crown is broad and rounded but still has beret character; lower head opening is a narrower continuous oval. No peak, no brim ledge, no rigid flat disc, no floppy wide sunhat brim, no knitted ribbing, no ear-shaped protrusions and no ear holes. No change of hat type between views. Color and material identical in every panel.
Important geometry: front-view slouch and stem position must rotate with the hat into each other view, never redesign or mirror arbitrarily. Side views show genuine crown depth and soft rear fullness. Back is the SAME continuous crown and rounded lower band, no new seam decoration. The underside view shows a continuous thick soft rim and ONE EMPTY OVAL opening with a lavender inner lining and open interior volume; it must not be sealed by a solid lavender bottom disk. The opening is for the cat's head, not two small ear holes. Interior is shaded gently enough to see cloth thickness, not a black void. The same-sized first four views share orthographic lens and consistent vertical alignment. Two inspection views may rotate the object but preserve proportions.
Lighting: soft even all-around studio fill, no cast ground shadow, no black AO, no glossy plastic shine, plain background. Refined tactile dense felt nap, NOT ornate embroidery or swirly decorative patterns. Readability comes from the rounded real form and broad soft folds. No dimension numbers, callout arrows, watermark, logos or other objects. This is a coherent design sheet, not different hat variations.
